The Challenge

As a party supply brand, Factory Direct Party needs to feel fresh all year long. Every month and season calls for new creative, from website visuals to social content, and keeping up with that pace takes a dedicated creative partner.

What We Do

We became their ongoing creative team. Each month we run a full content shoot, capturing the photos and videos they need for the season and stocking them with a month or more of content. We handle their social media content and marketing, produce bi-weekly email campaigns, and lead the creative direction that keeps every touchpoint on brand.
